QA checklist — agent-kit

75 scenario(s), generated from the living specs. Results stay in this browser until you export them as a run file for work/qa/runs/.

channels

channels.R1 — Every channel names the others

The documentation website, the repository README, the npm package, the plugin README and the CLI help shall each give the documentation URL, the MCP endpoint, the plugin install command and the npx command, all taken from `cli/lib/channels.mjs`.

channels.R1.S1 All sources list all channels @many
  • Given the docs "Channels" page (EN and ES), the repository README, the plugin README and the CLI help
  • When each is read
  • Then each contains the documentation URL, the MCP endpoint, the plugin install command and the npx command
channels.R1.S2 No stale placeholder @exception
  • Given the documentation and READMEs
  • When they are searched for `<your-vercel-deployment>`
  • Then nothing is found

channels.R2 — The website root works

When a visitor opens the GitHub Pages root, the website shall redirect to `/es/` if the browser prefers Spanish and to `/en/` otherwise.

channels.R2.S1 Root page generated @simple
  • Given a generated site without `index.html`
  • When the post-build step runs with the base `/agent-kit/`
  • Then `index.html` exists and sends the visitor to `/agent-kit/en/` without JavaScript
channels.R2.S2 Spanish browsers land in Spanish @boundary
  • Given browser languages `es-ES, en`
  • When the root page picks a locale
  • Then it is `es`; for `fr, de` it is `en`

channels.R3 — The plugin uses the docs MCP server

Where the plugin is enabled, the plugin shall declare the `agent-kit-docs` MCP server at its https endpoint and disclose in its README what is sent to it.

channels.R3.S1 Declared over https @interface
  • Given `plugin/.mcp.json`
  • When it is read
  • Then it declares `agent-kit-docs` with type `http` and the endpoint from `cli/lib/channels.mjs`, and the plugin README mentions the endpoint
channels.R3.S2 Live server answers @one
  • Given the deployed MCP endpoint
  • When an MCP client calls `list-pages` for `en`
  • Then it returns the documentation pages

channels.R4 — npm package metadata

The npm package shall set `homepage` to the documentation URL and set `repository`, `bugs` and `keywords`.

channels.R4.S1 Metadata set @simple
  • Given `package.json`
  • When it is read
  • Then `homepage` is the documentation URL, `bugs` points to the repository's issues, and `keywords` is not empty

plugin

plugin.R1 — Listing metadata

The plugin folder shall contain a README of at least 40 words outside code blocks, a license and a square PNG icon at `.claude-plugin/icon.png`, and `plugin.json` shall set `name`, `displayName`, `description`, `version`, `author`, `homepage`, `repository`, `license`, `keywords` and `privacyPolicyUrl`.

plugin.R1.S1 Manifest complete @simple
  • Given `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
  • When its fields are read
  • Then every listed field is set, `homepage`, `repository` and `privacyPolicyUrl` are URLs, and the marketplace entry has the same name, version and description
plugin.R1.S2 README long enough without code @boundary
  • Given `plugin/README.md`
  • When its words outside fenced code blocks are counted
  • Then there are at least 40, and `plugin/LICENSE` exists
plugin.R1.S3 Square icon in range @boundary
  • Given `plugin/.claude-plugin/icon.png`
  • When its PNG header is read
  • Then it is square, 512 to 2048 px on each side, and under 2 MB
plugin.R1.S4 Privacy page published @interface
  • Given the `privacyPolicyUrl` in `plugin.json`
  • When the docs site is built
  • Then the page exists in English and Spanish

plugin.R2 — Pinned launchers

The plugin shall run no package launcher without an exact version.

plugin.R2.S1 No unpinned launcher in the plugin @exception
  • Given every file in the plugin folder
  • When it is scanned for `npx`, `bunx`, `uvx` and `pnpm dlx` commands
  • Then each names its package with an exact version
plugin.R2.S2 The project's own tools first @one
  • Given a project with `node_modules/.bin/tsx` and `node_modules/.bin/vitest`
  • When a `.ts` script or a vitest test is run
  • Then the local binary runs; without it, `npx --yes tsx@4.23.15` or `npx --yes vitest@5.0.3`

plugin.R3 — The CLI version follows the plugin

When `bump.mjs` sets a version, the release script shall write it into every `@razcue/agent-kit@<version>` command in the plugin folder.

plugin.R3.S1 Commands re-pinned on release @one
  • Given a plugin file containing `npx @razcue/agent-kit@0.14.0 upgrade`
  • When the version is bumped to 0.14.1
  • Then the file says `npx @razcue/agent-kit@0.14.1 upgrade`

plugin.R4 — Environment stays local

The plugin README shall state that the scripts pass the user's environment only to the local tools they start and that nothing from it reaches the MCP server or any other service.

plugin.R4.S1 Disclosed @simple
  • Given `plugin/README.md`
  • When it is read
  • Then it says the environment reaches only local tools (git, commitlint, the project's tests) and never the MCP server
plugin.R4.S2 Guard without a download pattern @exception
  • Given `plugin/scripts/git-guard.mjs`
  • When its source is scanned
  • Then it contains no download command name (`fetch`, `curl`, `wget`) and still treats `git fetch` as read-only

qa

qa.R1 — QA settings at setup

When `init` runs, the CLI shall store `qa.checklist` and `qa.testData`, both on by default, and turn `qa.testData` on only for projects that use Supabase.

qa.R1.S1 Defaults on a Supabase project @simple
  • Given a new app monorepo with the `app` workspace
  • When `agent-kit init --yes` runs
  • Then `qa` is `{ checklist: true, testData: true, testPrefix: "TEST_", testDataDir: "supabase/test-data" }` and `work/qa/` exists
qa.R1.S2 No Supabase, no test data @exception
  • Given a blank project or a content site
  • When `init` runs, even with `--test-data true`
  • Then `qa.testData` is false and no test-data folder exists; an existing project using `@supabase/supabase-js` is detected

qa.R2 — Changed answers keep files

When the QA answers change by re-running `init`, the CLI shall store the new values and leave existing `work/qa/` and test-data files untouched.

qa.R2.S1 Answers changed, files kept @boundary
  • Given a project with an edited `seed.sql` and the prefix `QA_`
  • When `init --qa-checklist false --test-data false` runs
  • Then both settings are false, the prefix stays, and `seed.sql` and `work/qa/` are unchanged

qa.R3 — Checklist from the living specs

When `qa.mjs sync` runs, the CLI shall write `work/qa/checklist.md` and `checklist.html` with one item per living-spec scenario, grouped by capability and requirement, and change nothing on a second run.

qa.R3.S1 One item per scenario, stable @many
  • Given living specs with 2 capabilities and 5 scenarios
  • When the checklist is generated twice
  • Then it lists the 5 scenarios with their steps and ZOMBIES tags, and both outputs are identical

qa.R4 — Fixtures per scenario

When `qa.mjs sync` or `qa.mjs gaps` runs with test data on, the CLI shall show the seed fixture tagged with each scenario id, and list scenarios without a fixture and fixtures naming unknown scenarios.

qa.R4.S1 Fixtures mapped, gaps both ways @interface
  • Given `-- @fixture billing.R1.S1 billing.R1.S2 @boundary` and `-- @fixture ghost.R9.S1 @one` in `seed.sql`
  • When the checklist and the gaps are computed
  • Then `billing.R1.S1` shows `seed.sql:2`, three scenarios have no fixture, and `ghost.R9.S1` is unknown

qa.R5 — QA runs

When `qa.mjs run` runs, the CLI shall create `work/qa/runs/<date>.md` with every scenario unticked and its text hash, adding `-2`, `-3`… for more runs on the same day.

qa.R5.S1 Same-day suffix @boundary
  • Given a run already started today
  • When `qa.mjs run` runs again
  • Then the new file is `<today>-2.md`

qa.R6 — Latest result per scenario

When `qa.mjs status` runs, the CLI shall show each scenario's latest result, `re-check` when its text changed since that result, and `never run` when it has none.

qa.R6.S1 Re-check after a change @boundary
  • Given a scenario that passed and whose text then changed
  • When `qa.mjs status` runs
  • Then it shows `re-check`, an empty later row doesn't erase a result, and an untested scenario shows `never run`

qa.R7 — Offline checklist page

The checklist page shall work offline and export the recorded results in the run-file format.

qa.R7.S1 Export matches the run file @interface
  • Given `checklist.html`
  • When results are recorded and exported
  • Then the page loads nothing from the network and its export parses like a run file

qa.R8 — Test-data scaffold

Where test data is on, `init` shall create `env.sql`, `seed.sql`, `purge.sql` and a README in the test-data folder without overwriting existing files, each script in one transaction with the `_env` guard first and rows matched with `starts_with()`.

qa.R8.S1 Scaffolded with the prefix @simple
  • Given a new Supabase project
  • When `init --yes` runs
  • Then the four files exist with `TEST_` filled in and the monorepo init migration creates `_env`
qa.R8.S2 Transaction and guard first @boundary
  • Given the seed and purge templates
  • When their SQL is read
  • Then each starts with `BEGIN;` and the guard, ends with `COMMIT;`, never uses `LIKE` on the prefix, and `env.sql` sets no value

qa.R9 — Production guard

If `_env` is missing or says `production`, then `seed.sql` and `purge.sql` shall raise an error before changing any row.

qa.R9.S1 Refused outside dev / test / staging @exception
  • Given a database without `_env`, or with `_env` set to `production`
  • When `seed.sql` or `purge.sql` runs
  • Then it raises "test data refused" and nothing changes

qa.R10 — QA off adds nothing

If QA is off or the project has no Supabase or predates QA, then the kit shall add no QA files, tasks or session line until `upgrade` asks and the answers turn it on.

qa.R10.S1 Session line only when on @zero
  • Given QA settings off or missing
  • When the session context is built
  • Then there is no QA line; with the checklist on there is one, and test data adds its folder and prefix
qa.R10.S2 Project from before QA stays off @boundary
  • Given `agent-kit.json` without `qa`
  • When the QA settings and preflight checks are read
  • Then both checklist and test data are off and nothing is reported
qa.R10.S3 Upgrade asks and keeps files @interface
  • Given a project set up before QA, with its own `seed.sql`
  • When `agent-kit upgrade --yes` runs
  • Then the QA question is reported, the checklist is on, and `seed.sql` is unchanged

qa.R11 — Preflight on test data

If migrations change without seed or purge changes or the checklist is out of date or a fixture names an unknown scenario, then preflight shall warn and name the files.

qa.R11.S1 Warnings named @exception
  • Given a new migration, an out-of-date checklist and a fixture for `ghost.R9.S1`
  • When preflight runs
  • Then it warns about each; touching `purge.sql` clears the migration warning, and QA off reports nothing

setup

setup.R1 — Main branch detection

When `init` runs without `--main` in a git repository, the CLI shall set `mainBranch` to origin's HEAD branch or to the only branch named main, master, trunk, production or prod, and ask for it when neither identifies one branch.

setup.R1.S1 Only master exists @simple
  • Given a repository whose only branch is `master`
  • When `agent-kit init --yes` runs
  • Then `agent-kit.json` has `"mainBranch": "master"`
setup.R1.S2 Origin HEAD decides @one
  • Given origin's HEAD points to `production` and both `main` and `production` exist
  • When the main branch is detected
  • Then it is `production`, without a question
setup.R1.S3 Two candidates, not sure @many
  • Given branches `main` and `master`, no origin HEAD, the current branch `master`
  • When the main branch is detected
  • Then the result is `master` marked not sure, so an interactive `init` asks "Main (production) branch" with `master` as the default
setup.R1.S4 Not a git repository @zero
  • Given a folder that is not a git repository
  • When `agent-kit init --yes` runs
  • Then `mainBranch` is `main`
setup.R1.S5 The flag wins @interface
  • Given a repository whose only branch is `master`
  • When `agent-kit init --yes --main develop` runs
  • Then `mainBranch` is `develop`
setup.R1.S6 No usual name @boundary
  • Given a repository whose only branch is `develop`
  • When the main branch is detected
  • Then the result is `develop` marked not sure

setup.R2 — Configured branch re-checked on upgrade

If the configured `mainBranch` exists neither as a local nor as a remote branch, then `upgrade` shall replace it with the detected branch when detection is sure, ask for it in an interactive run, and keep it with a warning in a `--yes` run.

setup.R2.S1 Wrong branch corrected @exception
  • Given `"mainBranch": "main"` in a repository whose only branch is `master`
  • When `agent-kit upgrade --yes` runs
  • Then `mainBranch` becomes `master` and the output says so
setup.R2.S2 Existing branch kept @boundary
  • Given `"mainBranch": "master"` and the branch `master` exists
  • When `agent-kit upgrade --yes` runs
  • Then `mainBranch` stays `master` and nothing about it is printed

setup.R3 — Unasked fields survive a re-run

When `init` or `upgrade` rewrites `agent-kit.json`, the CLI shall keep every field it doesn't ask about, such as `testCommand` and `contextBudget`.

setup.R3.S1 Hand-set fields kept @boundary
  • Given `agent-kit.json` with `"testCommand": "node --test"` and `"contextBudget": 6000`
  • When `agent-kit upgrade --yes` runs
  • Then both fields are still there with the same values

specs

specs.R1 — Requirements in EARS

When `specs.mjs lint` checks a requirement, the linter shall accept only an EARS sentence (ubiquitous, event, state, unwanted, optional or complex) and report any other sentence with its id and the expected patterns.

specs.R1.S1 Every pattern recognised @many
  • Given one sentence per EARS pattern and one free-text sentence
  • When each is classified
  • Then the six patterns are recognised and the free text is not
specs.R1.S2 Free text reported @exception
  • Given a living spec whose requirement `auth.R1` reads "Throttle logins."
  • When `specs.mjs lint` runs
  • Then it reports `auth.R1: requirement is not EARS` with the expected patterns and exits 1

specs.R2 — Scenario notation

When `specs.mjs lint` checks a scenario, the linter shall report a missing or unknown ZOMBIES tag, missing or out-of-order Given / When / Then steps, a duplicate id, an id outside its requirement, an id outside the capability and a requirement without scenarios.

specs.R2.S1 Malformed scenarios reported @exception
  • Given scenarios without a tag, with `@happy`, without a Then step, with a duplicate id and with an id under another requirement
  • When `specs.mjs lint` runs
  • Then each problem is reported with the scenario's id
specs.R2.S2 Happy path only @boundary
  • Given a requirement whose scenarios are all `@simple`
  • When `specs.mjs lint` runs
  • Then it warns to consider `@exception` or `@boundary`, without an error

specs.R3 — Merge into the living specs

When `specs.mjs merge NNN` runs on an approved or done change, the merger shall append ADDED requirements, replace MODIFIED blocks, remove REMOVED requirements, retire removed ids and the scenarios a MODIFIED block leaves out, and mark the proposal `merged:` with the date.

specs.R3.S1 Added, modified, removed @many
  • Given a delta that ADDs `auth.R3`, MODIFIES `auth.R2` and REMOVES `auth.R1`
  • When it is merged
  • Then the living spec has R2 replaced and R3 appended, R1 gone, and `retired: [auth.R1, auth.R2.S2]`
specs.R3.S2 New capability @one
  • Given a delta for `billing`, which has no living spec yet
  • When it is merged
  • Then `work/specs/billing/spec.md` is created with its purpose and requirements
specs.R3.S3 Second merge changes nothing @boundary
  • Given a change already merged
  • When `specs.mjs merge` runs again
  • Then it says so and no file changes

specs.R4 — Merge conflicts

If a delta modifies or removes a requirement missing from the living spec or adds a taken or retired id, then the merger shall name every conflict and write nothing.

specs.R4.S1 Conflicts named @exception
  • Given deltas that REMOVE a missing `auth.R7`, ADD a taken `auth.R2`, ADD a retired `auth.R3` and MODIFY a missing `auth.R8`
  • When each is merged
  • Then each conflict is named and nothing is merged
specs.R4.S2 All or nothing @exception
  • Given a change with one valid delta and one conflicting delta
  • When it is merged
  • Then no living spec changes and the proposal is not marked merged

specs.R5 — Next free id

When `specs.mjs next` runs for a capability or a requirement, the CLI shall print the id after every living, retired and pending-delta id.

specs.R5.S1 Retired and pending ids skipped @boundary
  • Given `auth` with requirements up to R2, `auth.R7` retired and a pending delta adding `auth.R3`
  • When the next ids are asked for
  • Then they are `auth.R8` and `auth.R4`, and scenario ids skip retired and pending ones too

specs.R6 — Scenario trace

When `specs.mjs trace` or `work.mjs trace` runs, the CLI shall show for each scenario the tests whose name contains its id, its ✅ verification row, or "not covered".

specs.R6.S1 Tests and checks @one
  • Given a test named `auth.R1.S1 …` and a ✅ row for `auth.R2.S2`
  • When the scenarios are traced
  • Then those two are covered and `auth.R2.S1` is not (`auth.R2.S10` doesn't count for `auth.R2.S1`)
specs.R6.S2 A change traced by scenario id @interface
  • Given a change with a delta and a ✅ row in its tasks
  • When the change is traced
  • Then its rows are the delta's scenario ids

specs.R7 — Preflight on changes and specs

If a done change has an uncovered scenario or is not merged into the living specs, then preflight shall report a violation, and it shall warn about approved changes with gaps, uncovered living-spec scenarios and notation errors.

specs.R7.S1 Done blocks, approved warns @exception
  • Given a done change with an uncovered scenario, not merged, and an approved change with gaps
  • When preflight runs
  • Then the done change is two violations and the approved one a warning
specs.R7.S2 Notation errors as warnings @interface
  • Given an open delta whose requirement is not EARS
  • When preflight runs
  • Then the lint error appears as a warning with the file and id

specs.R8 — Old layout upgraded

When `agent-kit upgrade` runs on a project with `work/specs/NNN-slug/` folders, the CLI shall move them untouched to `work/changes/` and keep their `NNN/AC-n` traces working.

specs.R8.S1 Folders moved, traces kept @one
  • Given `work/specs/004-old/spec.md` with `**AC-1**` and a living spec `work/specs/auth/`
  • When the layout is migrated twice
  • Then the folder is in `work/changes/004-old/` unchanged, the living spec stays, the second run moves nothing, and a `004/AC-1` test still covers it
specs.R8.S2 Through the CLI @interface
  • Given an initialised project with `work/specs/003-old/`
  • When `agent-kit upgrade --yes` runs
  • Then it prints the move and the folder is in `work/changes/`

specs.R9 — The spec lane writes the notation

When the `spec` skill opens a change for complex work, the agent shall write a proposal and delta specs whose requirements are EARS and whose scenarios are Given/When/Then with ZOMBIES tags, passing `specs.mjs lint`.

specs.R9.S1 Live spec lane @simple
  • Given a scaffolded monorepo and a request for an invoices module
  • When Claude Code runs it with the plugin
  • Then the change has a proposal and lint-clean deltas

specs.R10 — Fast-track keeps the living spec true

When a fast-track change alters behaviour that a living spec describes, the `feature` skill shall update that requirement or scenario in place and `specs.mjs lint` shall pass.

specs.R10.S1 Live fast-track lane @simple
  • Given a living spec describing a "Sign out" button
  • When Claude Code renames it to "Log out"
  • Then the code and the living spec both say "Log out" and lint passes

website

website.R1 — Static Docus site

When the site workflow runs, the build shall generate the Docus site in `site/` to static files and publish them to GitHub Pages under the repository's base path.

website.R1.S1 Pages build @simple
  • Given a push to the main branch that changes `site/`
  • When the pages workflow runs
  • Then the generated site is published at https://razcue.github.io/agent-kit/
website.R1.S2 Assets under the base path @interface
  • Given the site is served from `/agent-kit/`
  • When a visitor opens any page
  • Then every link, image, script and stylesheet resolves under `/agent-kit/`
website.R1.S3 Broken build is not published @exception
  • Given a change that makes `nuxt generate` fail
  • When the pages workflow runs
  • Then the workflow fails and the published site stays as it was

website.R2 — Every page in every language

Where a locale is configured, the website shall serve every page in that locale at the same path, with a language switcher and localized interface strings.

website.R2.S1 Switch language keeps the page @simple
  • Given a visitor on `/en/reference/cli`
  • When they choose Español in the language switcher
  • Then they land on `/es/reference/cli`
website.R2.S2 Missing translation fails the check @exception
  • Given `content/en/guides/qa-pass.md` without `content/es/guides/qa-pass.md`
  • When the docs check runs
  • Then it fails and names the missing Spanish page
website.R2.S3 Interface strings localized @many
  • Given the Spanish site
  • When a visitor uses navigation, search and the table of contents
  • Then every interface label is in Spanish

website.R3 — Stale translations are reported

When an English page changes after its translation was written, the docs check shall report that translation as stale.

website.R3.S1 Edited source flags its translation @boundary
  • Given `content/es/concepts/lanes.md` recorded the hash of the English page
  • When one sentence of `content/en/concepts/lanes.md` changes
  • Then the docs check lists `es/concepts/lanes.md` as stale
website.R3.S2 Untouched source passes @zero
  • Given no English page changed since its translation
  • When the docs check runs
  • Then it reports no stale translation

website.R4 — Reference generated from the source

When `docs.mjs sync` runs, the release script shall regenerate the reference pages for CLI commands and flags, setup questions and `agent-kit.json` fields, skills, hooks and the changelog from the kit's source, and a second run shall change nothing.

website.R4.S1 New skill gets its page @one
  • Given a new skill folder `plugin/skills/foo/` with a description
  • When `docs.mjs sync` runs
  • Then the English skills reference has an entry for `foo` with that description
  • And the docs check reports the Spanish skills page as stale until it is translated
website.R4.S2 Idempotent @simple
  • Given the reference pages are current
  • When `docs.mjs sync` runs again
  • Then no file changes
website.R4.S3 Stale reference fails the tests @exception
  • Given a CLI flag added to the help text without running `docs.mjs sync`
  • When `npm test` runs
  • Then the docs test fails and names the stale reference page

website.R5 — Complete coverage

The documentation shall cover installation, every setup kind, upgrade, uninstall, every workflow listed in the proposal, and have a reference entry for every CLI command, skill, hook and script command.

website.R5.S1 Every CLI command documented @many
  • Given the commands listed in the CLI help
  • When the docs check runs
  • Then each command has a reference entry and at least one page that explains when to use it
website.R5.S2 Undocumented command fails @exception
  • Given a new CLI command without a reference entry
  • When the docs check runs
  • Then it fails and names the command

website.R6 — Machine-readable docs

The website shall publish `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` generated from the English content.

website.R6.S1 llms files published @simple
  • Given a successful build
  • When an agent fetches `/agent-kit/llms.txt` and `/agent-kit/llms-full.txt`
  • Then it gets the index and the full English documentation
website.R6.S2 Spanish pages stay out of llms-full @boundary
  • Given every page exists in English and Spanish
  • When `llms-full.txt` is generated
  • Then it holds each page once, in English

website.R7 — MCP server on Vercel

Where the site is deployed to Vercel, the deployment shall serve Docus's MCP server at `/mcp`, so agents can list and read the documentation pages.

website.R7.S1 Agent lists pages @simple
  • Given the site deployed to Vercel from `site/`
  • When an MCP client calls `list-pages` on `/mcp`
  • Then it gets every documentation page with title, path and description
website.R7.S2 Static build has no MCP route @interface
  • Given the GitHub Pages build (`nuxt generate`)
  • When it finishes
  • Then the static output contains no `/mcp` endpoint and the docs say where the MCP server lives
